data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for manipulating Android WindowManager LayoutParams dynamically at run-time.
data.what_it_does: It allows Flutter apps to dynamically manipulate Android WindowManager LayoutParams at run-time. Developers can add or clear flags like FLAG_SECURE or FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON for specific screens instead of the entire application lifecycle.
use_when: You need to disable screenshots for specific screens on Android.
You want to dynamically toggle Android window flags like FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON per route.
avoid_when: You need cross-platform support for iOS or other platforms.
You want declarative window management across multiple non-Android platforms.
strengths: Enables screen-specific security flags (like FLAG_SECURE) on Android.
Exposes the full range of Android LayoutParams flags.
weaknesses: Android-only with no iOS support planned or possible.
Most flags beyond FLAG_SECURE have not been tested thoroughly with Flutter.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android platform configuration as it wraps Android-specific WindowManager interfaces.
